# Dang Pham — Product & Visual Designer

> Product & Visual Designer in Ho Chi Minh City. Work spans mobile and web UI, visual and digital design, e-commerce creative, illustration, motion and AI-assisted creative production. Open to product, visual and digital design opportunities, including remote, relocation, contract and selected freelance work.

## Portfolio

## Independent Projects
- [Northstar RevOps](/projects/northstar-revops) — self-directed B2B SaaS revenue-operations concept covering forecasting, risk triage, dense data and deal-level workflows.
- [ReturnFlow Ops](/projects/returnflow-ops) — self-directed e-commerce operations concept covering return queues, refund exposure, SLA risk and approval decisions.
- [AdForge Creative Ops](/projects/adforge-creative-ops) — self-directed AI creative-operations concept with structured generation, human review and production handoff.
- [Thiên Kim](/projects/thien-kim) — independent AI visual-production system covering character art direction, identity continuity, shot planning, quality review and the idea-to-storyboard-to-production-prompt-to-saved-pack workflow.
- [Nexus UI Kit](/projects/nexus-ui-kit) — self-directed UI/design-system portfolio project covering reusable SaaS layouts, dashboards, components, responsive views and theme variants; not client work.
- [Soft Systems illustration portfolio](/illustration-portfolio) — self-directed 40-scene SaaS onboarding, empty-state, system-feedback and success illustration system with editable SVG and transparent PNG outputs.

## Capabilities
- Product & UX: Figma, responsive UI, user flows, wireframing/prototyping, information architecture and design-system work.
- Visual & Graphic: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, e-commerce/promotional design, digital/web visual design, typography/layout and illustration/icon systems.
- Motion & 3D: After Effects, Premiere Pro, Blender, UI motion and 3D illustration/animation.
- AI-assisted Workflow: art direction/visual QA, character consistency, image-to-video direction, shot planning and AI-assisted creative production.

## Source Policy
Public visual work is linked to the original Dribbble source where available. Self-directed concepts and portfolio artifacts are labeled as such; they are distinct from professional work and do not imply client outcomes. The portfolio avoids invented client names, campaign outcomes, KPIs and unverified performance claims.
